title: A source whose host gives only a page hash is compared per section, so an edit elsewhere on the page does not mark every fact on it changed
goal: For providers whose only signal is a text hash (code.claude.com, modelcontextprotocol.io, www.anthropic.com, docs.github.com in providers.csv), factdiff keeps a hash per heading section of the normalized document beside the page hash, and detect and the lookup revalidation report a fact's source unchanged for that fact when the section holding its anchor hashes the same, so only facts in edited sections are resolved; the per-source result line counts sections changed and unchanged; the suite tests a page whose other section changed.

notes: Premise (2026-10-11): factdiff.py detect --no-save on five code.claude.com sources (S743, S-av5665nf, S1800, S1824, S-fmj24q2u) reported all five changed by text hash in 7.3 s and resolved 212 facts: 134 verbatim, 8 modified, 5 not found, 65 unanchored; providers.csv gives code.claude.com, modelcontextprotocol.io, www.anthropic.com and docs.github.com no ETag. The anchor's heading column already names the section a fact's passage sits in.
